settings.heading: Why gut health matters for scooting, itching & restlessness
settings.text:
Intestinal parasites are more common than most owners think — a 2020 study found them at 85% of U.S. dog parks tested. Once they settle in, they can upset digestion and the balance of healthy gut bacteria.

The gut lining — the barrier between your dog's digestion and the rest of his body — is just one cell thick. When the gut isn't comfortable, it often shows up as scooting, paw licking, loose stools and 3AM pacing that look like “behaviour”.

settings.heading: What are the warning signs?
settings.intro: Here are the signals owners most often miss. Any two together are worth a closer look — and worth mentioning to your vet:
settings.items:
Scooting across the carpet
Licking paws
Indoor accidents after being house-trained
Pacing or restlessness at 2–3AM
Edginess on walks
Disrupted, restless sleep
Dull coat or itchy skin
Sudden picky eating or loose stools
